ionised_cno.statement: Amarsi 2019 Table 1 contains no C II / N II / O II — its only species codes are CI, OI and FeII. The empty ionised-CNO bins are the source's shape, NOT a filter we applied, and no ionised row is fabricated to fill them.

fe_ii.statement: Fe II IS in the source and is deliberately dropped by atomic_census() because this is a CNO intake. Recorded so an absence-by-filter is never read as an absence-by-source.

n_i.statement: table1.dat has no nitrogen at all. The five N I rows come from Amarsi et al. 2020 Table 1, the AGSS21-adopted N I set.
